name: accordion
description: Collapsible panels with spring-eased height animation and a rotating chevron.

name: apple-select
description: An iOS-style text highlight — a fixed span the author chooses, with a translucent accent band and a lollipop handle at each end.

name: avatar
description: Circular user representation in three variants — a soft white-topped gradient with initials, a single-letter tint, and a photo.

name: breadcrumbs
description: Accessible navigation trail.

name: button
description: Squircle button in three sizes and five variants.

name: calendar
description: Standalone month-view calendar components.

name: carousel
description: Three patterns.

name: checkbox
description: Squircle checkbox in three sizes.

name: chip
description: Pill-shaped label in six semantic colors and three variants — soft, solid, and outline.

name: circle-annotation
description: A hand-drawn circle scribbled around the text with generous inner padding, drawn on when scrolled into view.

name: color-picker
description: A big saturation/value swatch up front, a plain hue rail underneath — drag either to dial in a colour, or sample one straight off the screen with the eyedropper.

name: color-swatch
description: A row of color circles with a single active selection — the ring springs between swatches as you pick.

name: combobox
description: A dropdown you can type into.

name: command
description: A searchable ⌘K command menu with grouped items, fuzzy matching, full keyboard navigation, and per-item shortcuts.

name: conversation-timeline
description: At rest, a dense rail of thin marks — one per message, tightly packed.

name: date-picker
description: Input-triggered date picker with three variants: click-to-pick, date range, and a typed DD/MM/YYYY field.

name: dot-grid-loader
description: A 3×3 grid of dots with four personalities.

name: drawer
description: A panel that slides in from any edge of the screen.

name: dropdown-menu
description: An anchored action menu that grows from its trigger.

name: fade-text
description: Splits into words (or characters) and staggers each chunk with a blurred rise on enter and a softer, smaller exit — following the split-and-stagger and subtle-exit principles.

name: file-uploader
description: Two variants for picking and displaying files.

name: flower-loader
description: A cute little flower that spins slowly while its petals pulse in a wave — each petal blooms and eases back a beat after the one before it, so the wait reads as a flower gently opening and closing.

name: folder
description: A tactile folder — unified skeleton cards (or your own photos) tuck behind a frosted-glass front pocket.

name: frame
description: The raw, unopinionated content container — the base every other card builds on.

name: glow-button
description: A single-purpose CTA button — a rainbow color field glows from inside the pill along its bottom edge, never as an outside shadow, its hues drifting smoothly on a loop.

name: infinite-canvas
description: A draggable plane that never ends.

name: input
description: A text field with five built-in variants — name, email, username, password, and plain text.

name: kbd
description: A keyboard key cap.

name: logo-reveal
description: An opening sequence off a drafting table.

name: modal
description: A confirmation dialog that blocks the page until the user makes a choice.

name: multiselect
description: Multi-option selector with removable pills in the trigger for selected values.

name: otp-input
description: A row of individual digit boxes for one-time codes.

name: pagination
description: Page number navigation with smart ellipsis, prev/next arrows, and an active-page squircle pill.

name: popover
description: A generic floating panel anchored to a trigger — put any content inside.

name: pricing-card
description: A subscription tier card — plan name, price, a feature checklist (excluded items strike through), and a CTA.

name: product-card
description: A flexible e-commerce product card.

name: profile-card
description: An agent or user profile card.

name: progress
description: A linear progress bar.

name: qty-input
description: A compact +/− stepper for cart quantities, numeric settings, or any bounded integer.

name: radio
description: Squircle radio button in three sizes.

name: retro-typewriter
description: A vintage typewriter you actually type on.

name: scramble-text
description: Each character scrambles together first, then letters lock in one-by-one from left to right while the rest keep churning until the last one settles.

name: scroll-area
description: Scrolls with no visible scrollbar by default.

name: segment
description: A segmented control for switching between mutually exclusive options — the active indicator slides with a spring.

name: select
description: Single-option selector with an input-like trigger and a floating panel below it, matching Combobox.

name: selection-frame
description: That box Figma draws around a selected frame — corner handles and a crisp accent stroke.

name: separator
description: A thin divider between content.

name: shimmer-text
description: The loading shimmer every AI-native app reaches for.

name: slider
description: An inline field slider — a labelled, squircle row with a thin handle and the live value, matching the Input field's corner radius and smoothing.

name: spinner
description: An honest circular spinner that resolves into its own answer.

name: squiggly-underline
description: A hand-drawn, wavy underline that draws itself on when scrolled into view.

name: stat-card
description: A dashboard metric tile — icon, label, a big number, an up/down/neutral change chip, and an optional inline sparkline.

name: table
description: A typed, column-driven data table with alternating rows, a dark header, and horizontal scroll on overflow.

name: test-button
description: A fully rounded pill with a subtle rainbow inner glow along the bottom edge.

name: theme-toggle
description: A button that switches between light and dark mode with a circular expand view-transition animation and cross-fading icon swap.

name: time-picker
description: A field that matches Input, opening a split readout with snap columns and a sliding AM/PM control.

name: toast
description: Global notification toasts in four types — success, warning, error, and info.

name: toggle
description: A switch with some weight to it — the knob stretches along its direction of travel and settles on a spring, so the flip feels thrown rather than snapped.

name: tooltip
description: A lightweight, edge-aware tooltip that flips placement automatically when it would clip against the viewport.

name: typewriter
description: Types a string on character by character with a blinking caret.

name: typography
description: 22 semantic variants built on Inter Display.

name: video-player
description: A fully custom HTML5 video player with a live edge ambilight — colours along the frame’s perimeter bloom out behind the squircle, shifting with the picture.

name: voice-orb
description: A dotted 3D sphere for voice and agent UIs — grains on a globe, depth-sorted, slowly tumbling.
